title: HoneyVanilla
description: HoneyVanilla is a cozy vanilla style Minecraft pack with small improvements that make the game feel smoother and more relaxing. It keeps the original survival experience while adding a softer more aesthetic vibe.
body: SoftCraft is a cozy vanilla style Minecraft pack designed to keep things simple and relaxing. It adds small improvements that make gameplay feel smoother without changing the core experience. The focus is on a soft aesthetic with gentle visuals and a calm atmosphere. Everything still feels like classic survival but a bit more polished and enjoyable. It is perfect for players who want vanilla but slightly better. Just load in, explore, and enjoy a more peaceful Minecraft world.
